preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 1 <= len(stdin) <= 10**5 and all(c.islower() for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Input is a single non-empty string of lowercase Latin letters with length between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= len(stdin) for xi, li in parts) and all(li > 0 for xi, li in parts) and sum(li for xi, li in parts) == max_possible_length and len(parts) == k and parts == sorted(parts, key=lambda x: x[0])
postconditions.description: Output consists of `k` non-empty parts of the password, where each part is defined by its start position `xi` (1-based) and length `li`. The sum of lengths `li` is maximized, and the parts are ordered by increasing `xi`.

postconditions.expression: any(len(parts) == 1 and len(parts[0][1]) % 2 == 1 and parts[0][1] == len(stdin) for parts in possible_solutions) or any(len(parts) == 3 and all(li % 2 == 1 for xi, li in parts) and sum(li for xi, li in parts) == max_possible_length for parts in possible_solutions)
postconditions.description: If the solution consists of 1 part, it must be a palindrome of odd length and span the entire input string. If the solution consists of 3 parts, each part must have odd length, and the middle part must be a palindrome of odd length.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi + li - 1 <= len(stdin) for xi, li in parts) and all(stdin[xi-1:xi+li-1] == stdin[xi+li-1:xi-1:-1] if len(parts) == 1 else (stdin[parts[0][0]-1:parts[0][0]+parts[0][1]-1] == stdin[parts[2][0]-1:parts[2][0]+parts[2][1]-1][::-1] and stdin[parts[1][0]-1:parts[1][0]+parts[1][1]-1] == stdin[parts[1][0]-1:parts[1][0]+parts[1][1]-1][::-1]))
postconditions.description: The selected parts must form a valid password structure: either a single palindrome (odd length) or three parts where the prefix and suffix are reverses of each other, and the middle is a palindrome of odd length.

postconditions.expression: max_possible_length == max(sum(li for xi, li in parts) for parts in possible_solutions)
postconditions.description: The sum of lengths of the selected parts is the maximum possible for any valid password structure.
